'''JediMaster124 JediMaster124's Light Side Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[JediMaster124]]
* '''Published:''' 10 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' JediMaster124's Light Side Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed JediMaster124's Light Side Deck J.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I have some good cards in my deck.

== Strategy ==

What I do is build up all my starfighter or warriors up in place and then attack. I haven't won like this yet but I hope it will work someday.
